    # pair's dimensions appear in input heading, output heading; extract row blocks after each
    matches=list(re.finditer(r'Demo pair \d+ input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n', text))
    m=matches[0]; h,w=map(int,m.groups())
    out_start=re.search(r'Demo pair \d+ output \(\d+x\d+\):\n',text).end()
    in_rows=text[m.end():m.end()+0] # reparse bounded from next label
    in_end=text.index('Demo pair',m.end())
    input_block=text[m.end():in_end].strip().splitlines()
    out_end_match=re.search(r'\n\nSame instance\.',text[out_start:])
    output_block=text[out_start:out_start+out_end_match.start()].strip().splitlines()
    a=[[int(v) for v in row.split()] for row in input_block]
